$comment: SEED DATA — hand-entered for build step 1 so the relations INTERACTION is provable before the live pipeline exists. This file is not a data source and must not survive into production. Step 10 replaces every array below with live ingests (Wikidata bloc membership, UCDP GED, OFAC/EU sanctions lists) and deletes this file. The UI renders a persistent SEED banner whenever these facts are in use. Every entry carries the source it was checked against and the year through which it is asserted to hold.
notSeeded: African Union, ASEAN and the Arab League are not seeded. Countries whose only plausible relation runs through them will read as 'no data', which is the correct behaviour for step 1.
Sanctions are seeded at programme level only, not designation level.
Recalled-ambassador events are not seeded; the weight exists in the engine but no facts feed it yet.

blocs.note: Armenia announced a freeze on its participation in 2024 without formally withdrawing. Its membership here is formal, not operative — treat any ARM classification derived from this bloc as contested.

blocs.name: Gulf Cooperation Council
blocs.note: Scored as economic rather than defense: the Peninsula Shield Force exists but the Charter contains no Article 5-equivalent automatic commitment.

blocs.note: Founding five only. The 2024-onward expansion is seeded as pending because membership and participation status have moved repeatedly.

blocs.name: Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
blocs.note: Scored as economic/security cooperation, not mutual defense. The Charter contains no collective defense obligation.
